connectors.name: Obsidian
connectors.role: source of truth and local note store
connectors.first_action: Verify the vault structure and read 60-Rules/Obsidian Rules.md.

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.first_action: Read one approved page or database only, then save a source note into Obsidian.

connectors.name: Mail
connectors.first_action: Import one explicitly approved email thread; never scrape the mailbox broadly.

connectors.name: Granola
connectors.first_action: Copy or export one approved transcript into 70-Sources/Granola/.

connectors.name: Crisp
connectors.role: support/chat transcript source if the client uses Crisp
connectors.first_action: Read one approved conversation export only, then save it as a source note.
